name: Forgotten
summary: Forgotten is a first-person, narrative-rich game about the struggles of living with Alzheimer's and slowly losing oneself in the familiar surroundings of the home. You live out the daily life of a person with Alzheimer's. As you play you might realize that things are not where you left them, time might have elapsed, and you may not wholly recognize where you are. Family members will visit you, but you might find yourself losing the thread of conversation and losing track of who they are to you. Each day you get to collect pictures to put in a collage to try to make sense of the world around you.
